headline: Transfer rumors, news: Liverpool eye Endrick in case Minteh deal fails
description: Liverpool want Brighton's Yankuba Minteh, but they have a plan should they fail to make a deal. Transfer Talk has the latest.

headline: Roberto De Zerbi: Tottenham 'not a team yet' and lacking fight after Brentford defeat
description: Roberto De Zerbi has said that Tottenham are undercooked and "lacking fight" after they slumped to a 3-0 defeat at Brentford.

headline: Brentford are everything Spurs want to be. Can De Zerbi bridge the gap?
description: Brentford beat Tottenham Hotspur and new manager Roberto De Zerbi at their own game, showing the scale of the task ahead for the Italian.

headline: Nicol: Tottenham got bullied by Brentford
description: Nicol: Tottenham got bullied by Brentford

headline: Tottenham thumped by Brentford in Premier League opener
description: Tottenham's expensive summer rebuild was shaken to its foundations by rampant Brentford on an alarming opening day for Roberto De Zerbi's side.

headline: New season, same streak: Viral Man United fan's haircut challenge continues
description: Viral Manchester United fan Frank Ilett could have been days away from completing his haircut challenge. After defeat to Hull City, he's back to square one.
